item.title: How Safe Is Abbotsford Melbourne?
item.description:
Safety in Abbotsford — The Honest Answer

“Is Abbotsford safe?” comes up regularly from people considering a move here. At 4km east of the CBD with Victoria Park station on the Hurstbridge and Mernda lines, Abbotsford is an inner-city suburb with the characteristics that come with that — generally safe, well-populated during the day, and requiring the same awareness you would use anywhere in inner Melbourne.

Read our full Abbotsford suburb guide for the complete picture.

item.title: How Safe Is Kensington Melbourne?
item.description:
Safety in Kensington — The Honest Answer

“Is Kensington safe?” is probably in the top five questions people ask before moving here. At 4km from the CBD on the Craigieburn and Sunbury lines, Kensington is an inner-city suburb with the characteristics that come with that — generally safe, well-populated during the day, and requiring the same common sense you would use anywhere in Melbourne.
